correctness.rationale: The conditional local-time Poisson excursion construction is exact for symmetric edge jump rates. Conditional moments give fixed mean and affine 1/w variance. A mean-preserving Poisson-exponential Markov semigroup proves convex ordering. The positive-occupation strictness, stochastic incomparability, and singular limits follow analytically. Direct augmented-generator inversion plus symbolic checks passed 167 assertions; no finite check is substituted for general proof.

value.rationale: A natural graph perturbation admits a full convex-order classification across all conductances and finite weighted cores, exact sensitivity of fluctuations, and a rare-trap loss of uniform integrability.
